Title: Agent Studio
MissingIntegrationKey: No key for this integration. Add it in Integrations.
AdministratorNotice: Use only a trusted server. This global MCP token grants broad access, not just your characters. It is stored in the OS credential store, never in the profile. Checking access does not start agents.
AdminAccessFailed: Access was not saved. Check the server address and administrative MCP token (not a model key or web password).
SettingsHint: Click model, reasoning, voice or interval to edit this agent’s settings.
CatalogNotChecked: Catalog not checked yet. The saved model is never replaced automatically.
CatalogLoaded: Catalog received from provider. Select a model.
CatalogError: Catalog unavailable. Check integration, login and connection. No generation was started.
SelectModelAndVoice: Select a model and fill in the enabled voice fields.
VoicesLoaded: Voices loaded. Select this agent's voice.
Preview: Test version. Starting control uses your selected model and voice billing. Connecting to a server alone does not start the model.
Empty: Create an agent profile. Connections and paid requests never start automatically.
ProfileSaved: Profile saved. Agent is stopped; select its server and model next.
ConfigurationError: Could not load or save profiles. Check permissions, version conflicts and separate memory folders. Existing settings were not replaced.
UnsavedChanges: Unsaved changes. Save them or press Cancel first.
Error: Operation failed. Check the file and resolve any version conflict.
CredentialsNotice: Keys stay in Keychain / Credential Manager, separate from profiles. Checking presence does not contact the provider. Multiple profiles may reference one integration ID.
NewKey: New API key (stored key is never displayed)
KeySaved: Key saved in the operating system credential store.
KeyPresent: A key exists in the operating system credential store.
KeyStoreError: Credential store failed. Check OS permission and integration ID.
CodexLoginNotice: ChatGPT subscription is a separate billing method. Uses official Codex CLI authentication via codex login, not an API key. In-app login is still under development.
PairInstructions: In game: Escape → Agent Studio connection. Paste the code, check the request and approve access. The code expires in two minutes.
PairFailed: Access not approved. Check address, connection and code expiry.
SelectCharacter: Select a character. The model has not started.
ConnectionFailed: Cannot retrieve characters. Check connection and access.
StartFailed: Cannot start. Check character, model, credentials and workspace.
CloseExplanation: Active agents will stop and release their characters. Profiles and memory stay on this computer.
SelectProfileFirst: Select an agent to read its local memory.
NoDocuments: No memory documents in this workspace yet.
NoSoul: SOUL.md is missing from this workspace.
DocumentReadError: Cannot read this document. Check workspace, permissions and size. Nothing was overwritten.
ActivityReadError: Cannot read saved activity. Memory documents remain available separately.
NoSavedActivity: No saved intentions or diary entries yet. Full conversation transcripts are not imported into Activity.
SavedActivityNotice: Local history — saved intentions and diary, not a live session log.
StoppedNoRequests: Stopped · no requests from Agent Studio
